runs.outcome: Blocked before mutation on two independent problems, and the second one challenges the instruction. Machinery: the signed-manifest relationship registry is closed to StandardNameSource PRODUCED_NAME reconciliation, revival and migration; it cannot create or delete StandardName HAS_PARENT edges, so relocating children needs a new closed reparent-and-supersede program, and raw Cypher would fail the signed receipt and replay contract. Semantics: the three live children are not the same kind of quantity. Two are flux-coordinate derivatives of the umbrella, but the third is surface_area_of_flux_surface with 20 producers, described as the total area obtained by revolving the poloidal contour through one full toroidal revolution. Reparenting that onto poloidal_plane_cross_sectional_area_of_flux_surface, which is explicitly described as excluding the swept toroidal surface, would place a swept-surface quantity under a parent that excludes swept surfaces. That is the exact distinction the locked flux-surface-area decision protects. The umbrella is therefore doing real work as a generic parent over two different area concepts, and its description says so. Recommend the umbrella survives, with the naming question being whether area_of_flux_surface is self-describing enough as a generic parent.

node_definition.done_when: Six named WEST sources parked at the compose attempt cap are given one clean attempt and the per-source outcome is recorded. The six, all StandardNameSource rows at status failed with attempt_count 5 and last_error 'compose claim-attempt cap reached', are exactly: summary/global_quantities/tau_energy/value, pf_active/coil/current, barometry/gauge/pressure, equilibrium/time_slice/boundary/outline/z, equilibrium/time_slice/boundary/geometric_axis/z, ece/channel/position/z. Note that the boundary outline and geometric axis are GEOMETRIC PROPERTIES of the plasma boundary rather than coordinate axes, and the first three are canonical tokamak quantities, so all six are expected to be nameable. Clear attempt_count and last_error and return status to extracted for exactly those six source_id values, touching no other row, and record the changed-row count which must be 6. Then run 'imas-codex sn run --focus "summary/global_quantities/tau_energy/value pf_active/coil/current barometry/gauge/pressure equilibrium/time_slice/boundary/outline/z equilibrium/time_slice/boundary/geometric_axis/z ece/channel/position/z" --only compose --skip-global-maintenance --cost-limit 3' in the FOREGROUND. The --skip-global-maintenance flag is mandatory and is valid because --focus supplies an explicit scope: without it a scoped run performs graph-wide startup and post-drain maintenance writes, which a previous node of this session did by omission. Record for each of the six whether a name was produced and its spelling, or the new error text if it failed again, because a fresh failure reason is the finding this node exists to get. Report actual spend beside the 3 dollar ceiling and write the manifest with a non-terminal status BEFORE starting the run.
